onboarding.ai_step_title: Zero-key AI, powered by your terminal
onboarding.ai_step_lede: Press Tab in the launcher and ask anything — answers stream right in. Connect your existing terminal-authenticated CLI tools (OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, Claude Code) with zero API keys required, or configure cloud providers.
onboarding.ai_step_cli_detected_sub: No API key needed — uses your existing terminal authentication.
onboarding.ai_step_feature_web_search_desc: All models can search the live web and cite sources via built-in DuckDuckGo / SearXNG with zero configuration.

onboarding.welcome_subtitle: Meet Asyar — your keyboard-first command center

onboarding.featured_empty_tip_badge: Store feels empty? Don't be disappointed!

That's what people do — they create their own extensions, but forget to push them to the store, so you can easily create your own.
